name: AncientKazemon
xros_req:
DigiXros Requirements [DigiXros -2] [Kazemon] x [Zephyrmon] 
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend all of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon. None of your opponent's Digimon can unsuspend until the end of their turn.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait or [Avian], [Bird] or [Fairy] in any of its traits from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
